observation: Reviewer independently re-derived the planner's completeness claim rather than trusting it: refine-critique re-ran its own grep sweep of the plugin/default config surface to confirm 'only one violation' (plugin-configuration.ts importing ALL_TOOL_DEFINITIONS from tool-registry.ts) before passing, and separately caught a real implementation gotcha the plan would have hit — AC5's suggested validateConfigurationValue unit-test target is not exported (plugin-configuration.ts:184) — redirecting the builder to prove AC5 through the real loadBuiltInConfigurationDefaults projection path instead. Both critique and code-review (round 1) re-ran the guard script and should-graph audit themselves rather than accepting the builder's claimed pass/fail counts. Whole pipeline passed both critique gates and code review in a single round each (0 CRITICAL both critiques, 0 CRITICAL/0 WARNING code review) — worth protecting this reviewer-independently-reverifies-not-trusts pattern.

Builder's first attempt ended its turn while `npm run verify` was still running backgrounded, stranding the attestation; the orchestrator had to resume the builder explicitly and instruct it to block foreground on the already-running task. This exact failure mode (subagent backgrounds the long verify/attestation run and ends its turn) is now confirmed across at least 6 distinct work packages found in retro-log: AG4 (2026-06-13), AR1/AR2/AR4/AR6 (2026-06-29–30), and now AU10 (2026-07-11) — well past the 3-occurrence CONFIRMED threshold in compound-candidates.md's own schema, yet compound-candidates.md (last run 2026-06-28, before the AR1/AR2/AR4/AR6/AU10 recurrences) has no row for it at all. AR6's retro already proposed the structural fix explicitly ('the pipeline should never ask a builder to run the full long verify; the orchestrator should own it') but no compound-candidates.md row exists to track it toward that fix landing. Flagging for /compound to add a new CONFIRMED row (proposed ID e.g. 'C7 — builder-backgrounded-verify-strand') rather than let it keep recurring as scattered per-WP friction notes with no tracked fix target.

During the (foreground) verify re-run, the first attempt hit an unrelated native V8/WASM crash ('Check failed: end > addr.') mid-integration-leg on Node 24 under vitest-pool load, with no AssertionError anywhere in that run; matches the known load-flaky infra failure mode documented in AR1 project memory. Retry cleared it cleanly. Also had to revert an unrelated package-lock.json drift introduced as a side effect of `npm run knip`/build before finalizing the commit — low-severity but a repeated small tax on every verify cycle.

Cost/round signal for /compound: AU10 was a single, small, well-scoped leak-correction WP (one violation, 3 changed/new source files + 1 script + 1 test) and completed with refine-critique 1 round (score 9), architecture-critique 1 round (score 8.5), code-review 1 round (DONE, 0 CRITICAL/0 WARNING/2 non-blocking observations) — a useful low-round-count baseline to contrast against multi-cycle WPs like AU9 (5+ remediation cycles) in future round-count analysis. The only cost overrun was the builder-verify-strand friction (separate observation), not plan quality or review rounds.
